with w as (
  select a.district_id, sum(t.amount) as total_w
  from trans t join account a on a.account_id = t.account_id
  where t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  group by a.district_id
),
o as (
  select a.district_id, sum(od.amount) as total_o
  from "order" od join account a on a.account_id = od.account_id
  group by a.district_id
),
n as (
  select district_id, count(*) as n_acc from account group by district_id
)
select d.a2 as district_name, d.a3 as region, d.a4::bigint as population,
  w.total_w as total_withdrawn,
  round(w.total_w::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) as withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
  rank() over (order by round(w.total_w::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) desc) as rnk,
  round(coalesce(o.total_o,0)::numeric / n.n_acc, 2) as avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
from district d
join w on w.district_id = d.district_id
left join o on o.district_id = d.district_id
left join n on n.district_id = d.district_id
where d.a4::bigint >= 100000
order by rnk, d.a2

with fl as (
  select l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.duration, l.payments, l.status, c.client_id, c.birth_date,
         rank() over (order by l.amount desc) rk
  from loan l
  join disp d on d.account_id=l.account_id and d.type='OWNER'
  join client c on c.client_id=d.client_id and c.gender='F'
),
tx as (
  select account_id, count(*) tx_count, coalesce(sum(case when type='PRIJEM' then amount end),0) dep
  from trans where account_id in (select account_id from fl) group by account_id
),
reg as (
  select a3 region, round(avg(a11)::numeric,2) avg_sal from district group by a3
),
regloans as (
  select di.a3 region, count(*) n from loan l join account a on a.account_id=l.account_id join district di on di.district_id=a.district_id group by di.a3
)
select fl.client_id, fl.amount as loan_amount, fl.duration as duration_months,
  round((fl.payments*fl.duration)::numeric,2) as total_payments,
  round((fl.payments*fl.duration - fl.amount)::numeric,2) as interest_paid,
  fl.status as loan_status, di.a2 as district, di.a3 as region,
  tx.tx_count as transaction_count, round(tx.dep::numeric,2) as total_deposits,
  case when tx.dep > 2*fl.amount then 'High Income' when tx.dep > fl.amount then 'Medium Income' else 'Low Income' end as income_category,
  rl.n as loans_in_region, reg.avg_sal as region_avg_salary,
  extract(year from age(date '2026-10-09', fl.birth_date))::int as client_age
from fl
join account a on a.account_id=fl.account_id
join district di on di.district_id=a.district_id
left join tx on tx.account_id=fl.account_id
join reg on reg.region=di.a3
join regloans rl on rl.region=di.a3
where fl.rk<=3
order by fl.amount desc

with a as (
  select account_id, date from account where district_id=21 and date<='1996-12-31'
), o as (
  select d.account_id, c.gender, date_part('year', age(date '1996-12-31', c.birth_date))::int as age
  from disp d join client c on c.client_id=d.client_id where d.type='OWNER'
), cc as (
  select d.account_id, count(*) n from card k join disp d on d.disp_id=k.disp_id where k.issued<='1996-12-31' group by 1
), l as (
  select account_id, count(*) n,
    case when bool_or(status='B') then 'defaulted' when bool_or(status in ('C','D')) then 'repaying' else 'paid off' end lbl
  from loan where date<='1996-12-31' group by 1
), t as (
  select account_id, count(*) n,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where type='PRIJEM'),0) m_in,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where type in ('VYDAJ','VYBER')),0) m_out,
    max(balance) peak
  from trans where date>='1997-01-01' and date<='1997-12-31' group by 1
)
select a.account_id, a.date as opened, o.gender, o.age,
  coalesce(cc.n,0) as cards, coalesce(l.n,0) as loans, coalesce(l.lbl,'no loan') as loan_standing,
  coalesce(t.n,0) as txn_count, coalesce(t.m_in,0) as money_in, coalesce(t.m_out,0) as money_out,
  coalesce(t.peak,0) as peak_balance,
  rank() over (order by coalesce(t.peak,0) desc) as peak_rank
from a left join o on o.account_id=a.account_id
left join cc on cc.account_id=a.account_id
left join l on l.account_id=a.account_id
left join t on t.account_id=a.account_id
order by peak_rank, a.account_id

sql:
with last_race as (
  select cs.constructorid, r.year, cs.points,
    row_number() over (partition by cs.constructorid, r.year order by r.round desc, r.date desc) rn
  from constructorstandings cs join races r on r.raceid = cs.raceid
),
season_pts as (
  select constructorid, sum(points) pts from last_race where rn = 1 group by constructorid
),
ranked as (
  select c.name, coalesce(s.pts,0) as points, c.url,
    rank() over (order by coalesce(s.pts,0) desc) rk
  from constructors c left join season_pts s on s.constructorid = c.constructorid
  where c.nationality = 'Italian'
)
select name, points, url from ranked where rk <= 3 order by rk, name

sql:
with a as (
  select molecule_id, count(*) n_atoms, count(*) filter (where element='c') n_c, count(*) filter (where element='cl') n_cl
  from atom group by molecule_id),
cb as (
  select c.bond_id from connected c join atom x on x.atom_id=c.atom_id or x.atom_id=c.atom_id2
  where x.element='c' group by c.bond_id),
b as (
  select bd.molecule_id, count(*) n_bonds,
         count(*) filter (where cb.bond_id is not null) n_cbonds,
         count(*) filter (where bd.bond_type in ('=','#')) n_multi
  from bond bd left join cb on cb.bond_id=bd.bond_id group by bd.molecule_id)
select row_number() over (order by coalesce(b.n_cbonds,0) desc, a.n_atoms desc, m.molecule_id) as rank,
       m.molecule_id, m.label, a.n_atoms as num_atoms, coalesce(b.n_bonds,0) as num_bonds,
       a.n_c as num_carbon, a.n_cl as num_chlorine,
       coalesce(b.n_cbonds,0) as num_carbon_bonds, coalesce(b.n_multi,0) as num_multiple_bonds
from molecule m join a on a.molecule_id=m.molecule_id
left join b on b.molecule_id=m.molecule_id
where a.n_c>0
order by rank
